lines.trans: It is Hicham, I cannot take it anymore.
He is completely suffocating me.
And you, he is crushing you.
This is no longer possible.
I cannot take it anymore either.
What if we took off?
What? But where to?
We take all our talent clients.
We set up our own agency!
No, that is really impossible.
It is much too risky.
Of course it is risky.
But we will not be the first.
We would be our own bosses!
We can no longer work with him.
